The rig's own controller releases a fresh triage issue to todo within about a minute, and sibling daemons admit it; to seed a todo entry that is genuinely yours, create it, wait only until this daemon has consumed its issue.created (node present, lastAppliedSeq set), verify no tree and still triage, and stop the daemon within seconds.
